reconciliation: EStG66(3) rounds the amount when the statutory proportional-increase mechanism computes it. Its word dabei binds rounding to that mechanism.
DA-KG V23.1(1) sentence3 concerns payment of the amount already assessed. The assessed amount must pass through payment without a further rounding operation.

kindergeld_before_whole_euro_rounding is an intermediate proportional-increase calculation, not the assessed amount to be paid under V23.1. The existing monthly255/259 parameter and increase calculation do not encode a payment-of-assessed-amount rule.

A later EU differential or assessed amount with cents must not be passed through the proportional-increase rounding rule merely because payment is due. This is a composition constraint; no differential module is accepted by this review.
row_disposition: Retain bearing and unencoded. Paragraph1 also regulates notice/due date, monthly payment, prohibited advances/capitalization and continuity/diversion. Paragraphs2–5 add recovery demand, debtor, deadlines, set-off, late charges, reminders and enforcement rules. The entire row cannot be dismissed as a restatement of EStG66.
required_follow_up: Compose statutory rate calculation separately from payment of an issued assessment.
Native tests must retain an assessed amount containing cents at payment and still round a genuine statutory proportional increase under66(3).
Resolve the cited AO provisions and V33.4 diversion condition for the remaining procedural rules.
certification_effect: None; no status encoded or closed is asserted.
